messages:
emily: ok team — quick sprint: finalize 3 launch claim buckets + webinar hooks. goal: 2-week iteration, AB on landing + SDR scripts. who can lead?
noah: happy to lead on claims. recommended buckets: cost/perf economics, predictable latency/reliability, and deployment flexibility (hosted/dedicated/private).
raj: I'll run inbound routing tests — two lanes: developer vs enterprise. can we add a custom form field 'infraNeed'?
liz: SDR needs 6 one-liners per bucket. short, punchy, and one rebuttal each.
maya: bench team can produce 95p latency graphs and cost-per-1k-token for reference. ETA 3 days.
emily: awesome. maya — include prefix cache & batching notes. callouts: "2x token cost drop with KV caching" — tentative phrasing, we'll vet.
martin: growth Q: for webinar CTA, should we gate with an eval kit or a demo slot?
noah: offer both — gate advanced demo slots for enterprise, eval kit for dev signups.
raj: routing idea: webhook that tags "eval-kit" leads as dev tier and spikes SDR outreach after 48h if high token usage.
liz: love. send me raw one-liners, I'll spike on sequences.
emily: rough A/B test matrix — paste below
```
A: claim-led landing + short webinar sign-up
B: benchmark-led landing + gated eval kit
Metrics: signups, demo requests, SQL conversion, LTV proxy (avg tokens/day)
```
noah: I'll own content for benchmarks. maya will supply numbers. emily — can you draft hero copy?
emily: yes. draft in #marketing-drafts by EOD. ping me @noah @maya for rush.
deploy-bot: Scheduled post & webinar draft created: /campaigns/launch-0426
liz: I'll prep SDR pads after draft. tagging @maria for creative assets.
maria: on it. will produce 3 hero visuals: cloud-comparison, cost-graph, routing-diagram.
emily: great. next sync tomorrow 10am. please update boarding checklist in the doc.
